info.title: ShopNexus API
info.description:
The HTTP contract between the ShopNexus app and its server. The server
validates every request against this document, and the end-to-end suite
validates every response against it. The docs site explains each module:
https://docs.shopnexus.id.vn/en/api.

## Signing in

1. `POST /v1/auth/email-codes` mails a six-digit code to an email address.
2. `POST /v1/auth/sign-in` with that code returns an access token and a
   refresh token. The first sign-in of an address creates the account. A
   phone number Firebase verified or a Google account signs in the same way.
3. Send the access token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. It lasts 15
   minutes; `POST /v1/auth/refresh` returns a new one and rotates the
   refresh token.
4. A call that needs a sign-in within 15 minutes answers 428
   `reauth_required` after that. `POST /v1/auth/sessions/current/reauthenticate`
   with a new proof of the same account returns an access token that
   passes it.

In the playground, paste the access token under Authentication. It stays in
this browser only.

## Requests and answers

- Bodies are JSON. A field the schema does not list is 400.
- A write the app may send twice takes an `Idempotency-Key` header: a new
  UUID per user action, the same one on a retry. A repeated key returns the
  first answer.
- Lists page with `cursor` and `limit`; pass the `next_cursor` of one page to
  get the next.
- Every error has the body `{"error": {"code", "message", "fields",
  "details", "trace_id"}}`. `code` is stable and snake_case, and each operation lists the
  codes it can return. `trace_id` equals the `Trace-Id` header.
- A resource the caller may not see is 404, the same as one that does not
  exist.
- Any operation answers 429 `rate_limited`, with `details.retry_after` in
  seconds, when one address or one signed-in caller sends faster than its
  tier allows. `x-rate-limit` names an operation's tier; without it, GET
  is `read` and every other method `write`.

## Live updates

`GET /v1/ws` is a WebSocket that tells the open app what changed for the
caller; the playground cannot open it. `GET /v1/updates` returns the same
updates after a `since` seq, for an app with no socket open.

get.summary: Liveness: the process is up.
Readiness: the process can reach its dependencies.

post.summary: Sign in, or sign up on first use, with a phone number Firebase verified, a Google account or an email code.
post.description:
phone_token is what Firebase returned for the number: the ID token of
Firebase Authentication after an SMS code, or the Phone Number
Verification token of the SIM. google_token is the Google ID token
Credential Manager returned; it proves the account's email, and an
email identity with that address is the same account. email_code is
the code sendEmailCode mailed. A token must be at most 5 minutes old.
A repeated Idempotency-Key with a proof of the same address returns
the first sign-in's session with a new refresh token.

401.description: A token failed a check (invalid_phone_token, invalid_google_token), or a repeated Idempotency-Key's session was signed out since (session_revoked, session_expired).

422.description: The verified number is not a Vietnamese mobile number (invalid_phone), or the code is wrong (invalid_code, details.attempts_left), expired or replaced (code_expired) or out of guesses (code_locked).

503.description: The keys that sign phone or Google tokens could not be fetched yet (unavailable); try again.

post.summary: Mail a six-digit code to sign in, or sign up on first use, with an email address.
post.description:
The reply is the same whether or not an account holds the address.
The code lasts 5 minutes and takes 5 guesses. Limits: one code per
address per 45 seconds, five per address per hour, twenty per client
address per hour.

200.description: The code is on its way.

422.description: The address is not valid (invalid_email).

429.description: Too soon after the last code to this address (otp_too_soon), or over a limit (otp_limit); details.retry_after gives seconds.

post.summary: Rotate the refresh token and get a new access token.
post.description:
A refresh token works once. Presenting it again, or two refreshes
racing with one token, signs the session out. A suspended account
refreshes as any other; GET /v1/accounts/me tells it is suspended.

get.summary: List signed-in devices, newest first.

delete.summary: Sign out the session this request was made with.
delete.description: The access token keeps working until it expires, at most 15 minutes; the app discards it.

post.summary: Prove again that the caller holds the account, for the calls that need a sign-in within 15 minutes.
post.description:
Takes a proof as signIn does: a phone_token, a google_token or an
email_code from sendEmailCode. The proof must name a phone number or
an email address of the caller's account. A proof of another account,
or of an address no account holds, is wrong_account, and no account
is created or changed. The session's sign-in time becomes the time the
proof was checked. The reply is a new access token that carries it;
the refresh token stays as it was, and the tokens it refreshes carry
the new time too. A repeated Idempotency-Key with a proof of the same
address answers as the first request did and keeps the first
request's sign-in time.

200.description: A new access token with the new sign-in time.

401.description: Not signed in (unauthenticated, invalid_token), or the session was signed out or has expired (session_revoked, session_expired).

403.description: The proof names no phone number or email address of the caller's account (wrong_account), or the account is suspended (account_suspended).

409.description: Another guess at the same code was counted at the same moment (try_again).

422.description: A token failed a check (invalid_phone_token, invalid_google_token), the verified number is not a Vietnamese mobile number (invalid_phone), or the code is wrong (invalid_code, details.attempts_left), expired or replaced (code_expired) or out of guesses (code_locked).

503.description: The keys that sign phone or Google tokens could not be fetched yet (unavailable); try again.

delete.summary: Sign out every session of the account but the one this request was made with.
delete.description:
Needs a sign-in within the last 15 minutes. The signed-out devices'
refresh tokens answer session_revoked, and their push tokens get no
more pushes.

204.description: Every other session is signed out.

delete.summary: Sign one device out.

get.summary: Read the caller's account.

patch.summary: Change the display name, the bio, the avatar or away mode.
patch.description:
A new avatar is processed before the reply, which carries its URL.
away_until sets or clears away mode (tạm nghỉ): until then, buyers
cannot make an offer, accept a price or ask for COD on the caller's
listings (409 seller_away), while chat, the caller's own moves and
orders already placed go on.

422.description: The name, the bio or away_until breaks a rule (invalid_account, with fields), or the avatar upload is not the caller's or not a photo media can process (invalid_upload).

delete.summary: Delete the caller's account.
delete.description:
Needs a sign-in within 15 minutes. The account's listings, profile,
sign-in methods, addresses, saves, search history, blocks, follows and
notifications go, and its sessions end. The row stays without a name,
bio or avatar for the orders, reviews and messages that name it, where
other people see the account as deleted. A phone of the account signs
up again as a new account. The recipients of the orders it bought are
blanked a year later.

409.description: An order of the caller is pending or shipped (orders_open), or the account changed twice during the call (try_again).

post.summary: Mail a six-digit code that adds this email address to the caller's account.
post.description:
The code works only for the caller's account, through
POST /v1/accounts/me/identities. Needs a sign-in within 15 minutes.
Limits as for sendEmailCode.

200.description: The code is on its way.

422.description: The address is not valid (invalid_email).

429.description: Too soon after the last code to this address (otp_too_soon), or over a limit (otp_limit); details.retry_after gives seconds.

post.summary: Add the phone or email the caller's account lacks.
post.description:
A phone_token adds a phone to an account that has only an email;
google_token or email_code (from sendMyEmailCode) adds an email to an
account that has only a phone. Needs a sign-in within 15 minutes: a
sign-in method is never removed, so one added with a leaked access
token would let its holder in for good.

200.description: The account's identities after the add.

401.description: Not signed in (unauthenticated, invalid_token), or the account was deleted (session_revoked).

409.description: The account has this kind already (identity_kind_taken), another account signs in with this value (identity_taken), or a race (try_again).

422.description: A token failed a check (invalid_phone_token, invalid_google_token), the verified number is not a Vietnamese mobile number (invalid_phone), or the code is wrong (invalid_code, details.attempts_left), expired or replaced (code_expired) or out of guesses (code_locked).

post.summary: Block an account.
post.description:
Neither the caller nor the account may then message the other, open a
conversation with them or open a deal on their listings. Blocking
again changes nothing; running deals and orders stay as they are.

404.description: No such account (account_not_found).

409.description: ShopNexus cannot be blocked (account_is_system).

422.description: The caller named themselves (invalid_block).

get.summary: List the accounts the caller blocks, newest block first.

delete.summary: Lift a block; an absent one is fine.

post.summary: Follow an account.
post.description:
The caller hears when the account first publishes a listing.
Following again changes nothing. A block between the two, either way,
refuses a follow, and blocking deletes the follows between them.

403.description: The caller is suspended (account_suspended), or a block stands between the two (blocked).

404.description: No such account (account_not_found).

409.description: The caller follows 1,000 accounts (follow_limit_reached), or the account was deleted (account_deleted).

422.description: The caller named themselves (invalid_follow).

get.summary: List the accounts the caller follows, newest follow first.

delete.summary: Stop following an account; an absent follow is fine.

get.summary: List the caller's addresses, the default first, then the newest.

200.description: Every address of the caller's, at most 10.

post.summary: Add an address; the first becomes the default.
post.description:
With is_default true the address becomes the default in the same
request. A repeated Idempotency-Key returns the address its first
request added, as it is now, and changes nothing, the default
included.

409.description: The caller has 10 addresses (address_limit_reached).

422.description: The address breaks a rule (invalid_address, with fields).

put.summary: Replace an address of the caller's.
put.description:
With is_default true the address also becomes the default; without
it the default stays where it is. Orders already requested to the
address keep the copy they took.

404.description: No such address of the caller's (address_not_found).

409.description: The address changed meanwhile (try_again).

422.description: The address breaks a rule (invalid_address, with fields).

delete.summary: Delete an address of the caller's.
delete.description:
When it was the default, the newest remaining address becomes the
default. Orders already requested to it keep the copy they took.

404.description: No such address of the caller's (address_not_found).

post.summary: Make an address of the caller's the default.

404.description: No such address of the caller's (address_not_found).

post.summary: Get a presigned URL to upload one photo or video to.
post.description:
The app PUTs the file to `url` with `headers` before `expires_at`;
the URL fixes the content type and length. Attach a photo to a
listing, or read a video with POST /v1/listing-reads, within 24 hours,
or the upload is deleted.

post.summary: Read a video or a photo into a listing draft.
post.description:
Starts reading what the body names: a video the caller uploaded with
POST /v1/uploads, or one photo upload of the caller's.
A video may carry the phone's transcript; then the server runs no
speech recognition.
The answer comes at once with status reading. Each step that finishes
adds its fields and sends a listing_read update on /v1/ws; the app
then reads the read with GET. Checks, in order: account_suspended,
phone_required, read_limit_reached (30 video reads or 60 photo reads
in 24 hours), then invalid_upload.

403.description: The account is suspended (account_suspended), or has no phone to sign in with (phone_required).

422.description:
The video is not the caller's, not a video, not uploaded yet, expired or already read (invalid_upload); the
photo is not the caller's, not a photo, not uploaded yet, already in a listing or expired (invalid_upload).

429.description: The account started as many reads of this source as its cap allows in the last 24 hours (read_limit_reached).

get.summary: Read a listing read.

200.description: The read as it is now.

404.description: No such read for this caller, or it is past its 24 hours (listing_read_not_found).

get.summary: Watch a listing read as the model writes it.
get.description:
A server-sent event stream. It sends event read with the read as GET
/v1/listing-reads/{id} answers it, then event text with the title and
description each time the model has written more, then event read
again when the read ends, and closes. A read that has ended gets one
event read. A comment line every 15 s keeps the stream open; the
stream closes 30 s after the read's 2-minute deadline at the latest.

200.description:
The events. Each data line is JSON: a ListingRead after event read,
a ReadText after event text.

404.description: No such read for this caller, or it is past its 24 hours (listing_read_not_found).

post.summary: Price a listing draft against similar listings and the buyers watching for it.
post.description:
Compares the draft with the listings most like it, by text and by
photo, and answers the range, the two suggestions, the similar
listings, their prices, and the search watches a listing of the draft
would match. Stores nothing. POST because the body carries the draft.

200.description: The guide; empty lists when nothing is similar.

403.description: The account is suspended (account_suspended).

422.description:
The category is not a subcategory or the commune is not on the list
(invalid_listing, with fields); a photo is not the caller's, not a
photo, already in a listing or expired (invalid_upload).

get.summary: The caller's linked Chợ Tốt profile, if any.

200.description: The link, or null when none is linked. It reads ShopNexus only, never Chợ Tốt.

put.summary: Link the Chợ Tốt profile whose bio holds the caller's code.
put.description:
Reads the profile from Chợ Tốt and links it when its "Giới thiệu về
trang" holds the caller's live code, case, spaces and dashes aside.
The code is used up; the seller may then take it out of the bio.

A profile maps to one ShopNexus account. Linking one that another
account linked moves it here, since the code proves who holds it, and
that account's link is removed; its imported listings stay and stop
following Chợ Tốt. Linking another profile replaces the caller's.
Linking the same profile again keeps its settings. Listings already on
Chợ Tốt at linking are not imported on their own: only newer ones are,
while auto_import is on.

Checks, in order: invalid_profile_url, code_expired (no live code),
chotot_profile_not_found, chotot_unavailable, code_not_found.

404.description: Chợ Tốt has no such profile (chotot_profile_not_found).

422.description: Not a Chợ Tốt profile's address (invalid_profile_url); no live code, so ask for a new one (code_expired); or the profile's bio does not hold the code (code_not_found), with details.profile, the profile's name and avatar, so the app shows which profile it read.

404.description: No profile is linked (chotot_not_linked).

delete.summary: Unlink the caller's Chợ Tốt profile.
delete.description: Imported listings stay on ShopNexus and stop following Chợ Tốt. Also 204 when none is linked.

post.summary: The code that links the caller's Chợ Tốt profile.
post.description:
The live code when the caller has one, otherwise a new one for 30
minutes. The seller puts it in their profile's "Giới thiệu về trang"
and sends the profile's address with PUT /v1/me/chotot.

get.summary: The linked profile's listings on sale on Chợ Tốt, each with what it is on ShopNexus.
get.description:
Reads Chợ Tốt each call. The app polls it after POST
/v1/me/chotot/imports until no listing is importing; the imports with
review or a draft are what needs the seller ("Cần bạn xem").

404.description: No profile is linked (chotot_not_linked).

post.summary: Post an imported listing that waits as a draft, with the fields the seller filled.
post.description:
The body is the whole listing, as for POST /v1/listings; the draft's
photos are the caller's uploads. A listing already posted answers its
import as it is. Refusals are those of POST /v1/listings.

403.description: The account is suspended (account_suspended), or has no phone to sign in with (phone_required).

404.description: No profile is linked (chotot_not_linked), or no import of that listing waits as a draft (chotot_draft_not_found).

409.description: The seller has 20 listings on sale (listing_cap_reached).

422.description: A field breaks a rule (invalid_listing, with fields and details.missing_spec_keys), or an upload is not the caller's or already used (invalid_upload).

post.summary: Bring the chosen Chợ Tốt listings over as listings.
post.description:
Starts one import per listing and answers at once. An import reads
the listing from Chợ Tốt, checks it is the linked profile's, has the
model write the title and description, takes the category, condition
and specs, copies its photos (copied: true), takes the commune of the
caller's default address (or of their newest listing), and posts it
like POST /v1/listings. Each listing is imported once per account:
a listing already listed, a draft or one still importing answers as
it is, so a retried request needs no Idempotency-Key. A listing of
another profile is skipped as not_yours.

202.description: Each chosen listing's import as it is now, in the order asked.

404.description: No profile is linked (chotot_not_linked).

post.summary: Post a listing.
post.description:
The listing starts in processing while its photos are processed, then
turns active, or rejected when a photo is refused. Checks, in order:
account_suspended, listing_cap_reached (20 listings in
processing, active, hidden, rejected or reserved), invalid_listing,
invalid_upload.

Vary.description: Accept-Language, on a response whose text follows the request's language, so a cache keeps one copy per language.

403.description: The account is suspended (account_suspended), or has no phone to sign in with (phone_required).

409.description: The seller has 20 listings in processing, active, hidden, rejected or reserved (listing_cap_reached).

422.description: A field breaks a rule (invalid_listing, with fields; details.missing_spec_keys when specs the category asks for lack a value), or an upload is not the caller's, not uploaded yet, or already used (invalid_upload).

get.summary: Read a listing.
get.description:
Anyone may read an active listing. Its seller, signed in, also reads it
in any other status; anyone else gets 404.

Vary.description: Accept-Language, on a response whose text follows the request's language, so a cache keeps one copy per language.

404.description: No such listing for this caller (listing_not_found).

put.description:
The body is the whole listing, as when posting. Photos not in the
listing yet take it back to processing until they are processed; an
edit of a rejected listing does too. Sold listings cannot be edited.
It takes no Idempotency-Key: a retry writes the same content again.

Vary.description: Accept-Language, on a response whose text follows the request's language, so a cache keeps one copy per language.

404.description: No such listing of the caller's (listing_not_found).

409.description: The listing is sold or deleted (listing_state_conflict), or changed meanwhile (try_again).

422.description: A field breaks a rule (invalid_listing, with fields; details.missing_spec_keys when specs the category asks for lack a value), or an added upload is not the caller's, not uploaded yet, or already used (invalid_upload).

delete.summary: Delete a listing.

404.description: No such listing of the caller's (listing_not_found).

409.description: The listing is already deleted (listing_state_conflict), or changed meanwhile (try_again).

post.summary: Take an active listing off sale.

Vary.description: Accept-Language, on a response whose text follows the request's language, so a cache keeps one copy per language.

404.description: No such listing of the caller's (listing_not_found).

409.description: The listing is not active (listing_state_conflict), or changed meanwhile (try_again).

post.summary: Put a hidden listing back on sale.

Vary.description: Accept-Language, on a response whose text follows the request's language, so a cache keeps one copy per language.

404.description: No such listing of the caller's (listing_not_found).

409.description: The listing is not hidden (listing_state_conflict), ShopNexus hid it and only ShopNexus puts it back on sale (listing_held), or it changed meanwhile (try_again).

post.summary: Record a sale made off the app.

Vary.description: Accept-Language, on a response whose text follows the request's language, so a cache keeps one copy per language.

404.description: No such listing of the caller's (listing_not_found).

409.description: The listing is not active or hidden (listing_state_conflict), or changed meanwhile (try_again).

post.summary: Undo marking a listing sold; it goes back on sale.

Vary.description: Accept-Language, on a response whose text follows the request's language, so a cache keeps one copy per language.

404.description: No such listing of the caller's (listing_not_found).

409.description: The listing is not sold (listing_state_conflict), the seller has 20 listings in processing, active, hidden, rejected or reserved (listing_cap_reached), or it changed meanwhile (try_again).

post.summary: Copy the photos of one of the caller's listings into new uploads, to post a new listing from them.
post.description:
For Đăng lại. Each processed photo of the listing, in order, becomes
a new waiting upload of the caller's, which POST /v1/listings and
PUT /v1/listing-drafts/{id} take like a photo the app put; the
listing keeps its own photos. An upload expires 24 hours after the
copy unless a listing takes it or a draft keeps it. A photo copied
from the caller's listing on another site stays marked copied once
the new listing is processed. A photo not processed yet is left out.
Any status but deleted may be copied. A repeated Idempotency-Key for
the same listing returns the same uploads, with fresh URLs; a new key
makes new ones.

201.description: The new uploads, in the listing's photo order.

404.description: No such listing of the caller's, or it is deleted (listing_not_found).

get.summary: List the caller's drafts.
get.description:
Every draft of the caller's, in full, last edited first; at most 20,
so there are no pages. Drafts past expires_at are deleted first.

get.summary: The boost packages and their prices.
get.description:
A boost moves one of the seller's listings to the top of the newest
order at once and again every 24 hours until the package ends. Only
the newest order moves: relevance, nearest and price sorts do not.

post.summary: Buy a boost package for one of the caller's listings.
post.description:
Opens a payment of the package's price and returns the boost,
awaiting payment, with the gateway's payment_url; the package starts
when the gateway confirms the payment, at most 15 minutes later.
Checks, in order: payment_unavailable; unknown_boost_package;
account_suspended; phone_required; listing_not_found (no such
listing, another seller's, or deleted); listing_not_boostable (not on
sale: processing, hidden, held by a moderator, rejected, reserved or
sold); boost_active (a package runs on the listing); boost_pending
(another package awaits payment on the listing).

A boost of the same package awaiting payment on the listing is
answered as it is (200), so the seller picks the payment up again. A
boost of another package awaiting payment refuses the purchase until
it is paid or lapses. Nothing is refunded: once paid, the package
runs its days, and a day the listing is not on sale is not moved up.

200.description: The boost a repeated key made, or the listing's boost of the same package still awaiting payment, as it is now.

403.description: The account is suspended (account_suspended), or has no phone to sign in with (phone_required).

404.description: No such listing of the caller's (listing_not_found).

409.description: The listing is not on sale (listing_not_boostable), a package runs on it (boost_active, with details.boost_id), or another package awaits payment on it (boost_pending, with details.boost_id).

422.description: No package has that id (unknown_boost_package).

get.summary: One of the caller's boosts.
get.description:
The app reads it after the payment page closes, until the status
leaves awaiting_payment: the gateway's confirmation can come a few
seconds after the browser returns.

404.description: No such boost of the caller's (boost_not_found).

get.summary: Where VNPay sends the payer's browser back.
get.description:
VNPay's vnp_ReturnUrl, with the payment's vnp_ parameters and
vnp_SecureHash. A valid signature on a pending payment that VNPay
calls paid makes the server ask VNPay itself (querydr); the redirect
alone never marks a payment paid. The answer is a small page in the
request's language that tells the result and opens the app at
shopnexus://boost/{boost_id}, with a button for a browser that does
not follow it. A bad signature or an unknown payment gets a page that
says so.

get.summary: VNPay's payment notification (IPN).
get.description:
VNPay calls it server to server with the payment's vnp_ parameters.
The server checks vnp_SecureHash, finds the payment by vnp_TxnRef,
checks vnp_Amount, then records the result once: vnp_ResponseCode and
vnp_TransactionStatus 00 mark it paid, anything else failed. A
success after the payment failed or expired still marks it paid and

get.summary: The WebSocket that tells the open app what changed for the caller.
get.description:
Frames are JSON text messages of at most 4 KB. On connect the server
sends the caller's updates after `since` (none without it), or
`{"type":"reset","seq":N}` when the log no longer holds them, then
`{"type":"ready","seq":N}`. After that it sends each update as
`{"type":"update","seq":N,"kind":…,…ids}`, with the IDs of the Update
schema, in seq order, with no duplicate and no hole, and
`{"type":"typing","conversation_id":…}` when the other member types.
The app keeps the last seq and passes it as `since` on its next
connect; after `reset` it reloads everything.

The app sends its access token in `Authorization: Bearer`. A browser,
which cannot set that header on a WebSocket, offers the subprotocols
`bearer` and the token, as `new WebSocket(url, ["bearer", token])`
does (`Sec-WebSocket-Protocol: bearer, <token>`). Without an
Authorization header, a request offering exactly these two is checked
as if the token were in the header, and the handshake selects
`bearer`. A missing or bad token is 401 before the upgrade, either
way. A request with an `Origin` header opens the socket only from one
of the website's origins (`WEBSITE_ORIGINS`), scheme and host, or the
API's own host; another origin is 403. A request without `Origin`,
as the app's, is not checked. The server reads no token from the
query string.

The kinds, the IDs each carries, what logs one and who gets it:

- `message` (conversation_id, message_id): a message is written or
  its status changes. Every member of the conversation gets it once
  the message is sent; while it is processing, or after it failed,
  only the sender does.
- `read` (conversation_id): a member's read marker moves forward, for
  the other member; a member marks the conversation unread, or clears
  that mark by reading, for that member.
- `deal` (deal_id): each save of a deal: a move (an offer, accept,
  decline, withdraw, cancel), a COD order, or any change to its order
  (the shipment, the carrier's status, receipt, completion), for the
  buyer and the seller. Opening a deal logs no update, so its first
  one comes with the move after the opening.
- `notification` (notification_id): a notification is added, or an
  unread one with the same collapse key is bumped, for its recipient.
- `scam_warning` (conversation_id): a scam warning in the conversation
  is raised, grows, or is dismissed, for the warned member.
- `listing_read` (listing_read_id): a listing read (video, photo or
  link) starts or one of its steps is saved, for the account reading.
- `ticket` (conversation_id): a support ticket is created, its first
  message is attached, or it is resolved or reopened, for the ticket owner.

The app sends `{"type":"typing","conversation_id":…}` (at most one in
3 seconds per conversation reaches the other member) and, before its
access token expires, `{"type":"auth","token":…}` with the new one.

Close codes: 1001 server shutting down (reconnect at once); 4001 token
expired, invalid or another account's (refresh, then reconnect); 4003
account suspended (do not reconnect); 1008 a frame that is not JSON
text or has an unknown type, or more frames than 10 at once and one a
second after that; 1009 a frame over 4 KB. The server pings every 25
seconds.

same position and radius_km; its next_cursor pages on there. Without
radius_km the feed keeps within 50 km. Without a position nearby has
no items, and the app asks for a position to fill it. for_you and

who is not the seller also gets `viewer`, and the read counts as a
view of the listing, once per reader and UTC day; a signed-out read
counts none (GET /v1/screens/my-listings). A prefetch (Sec-Purpose)
counts none either: the client counts the open with
PUT /v1/viewed/{listing_id} when the person sees the page. With a
position the view has distance_km, measured as GET /v1/search
measures it.

get.description:

get.summary: Search active listings; without q, browse them.
get.description:
Three ways to search, all under the person's filters and sorts. With q
from a signed-in caller a model reads the query; BM25 on its words, its
Vietnamese rewrite against listing text vectors and its English
description against listing photos are fused by weighted RRF. A guest's
q searches its raw words through BM25 alone, on the listing text with
diacritics folded away and one edit allowed in long words; a caller's
q past 200 model reads that UTC day adds their text vector. Neither
has chips. A guest's
address makes 2 searches with q a second, in bursts of 30; past them
429. With photo, the photo against listing photos
alone. With like, the listing's title, text vector and photos. Without
any, the call browses, newest first by default, and category alone is the
category page. sort=nearby is the "Gần bạn" feed, which Home's first page
comes from. A model that fails leaves the lists it feeds out; q then
searches its raw words, with no chips. A signed-in caller's first page
with q is kept in the search history, and a signed-in caller never sees
the listings they hid nor those of an account on either side of their
blocks. With watch, a watch of the caller's runs its query and filters.
photo and watch need a signed-in caller. province keeps the listings of
one province and goes with every other
filter. seller keeps one seller's listings, the search of a seller's
page; it goes with every filter but watch, and its pages enter no
search history and carry no watch_id, since neither holds a seller.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: A root or subcategory code from GET /v1/categories.

parameters.name: province
parameters.description: A province code from GET /v1/regions, such as 01 for Hà Nội; keeps the listings whose commune is in it. An unknown code is invalid_province.

parameters.name: seller
parameters.description: An account ID; keeps that seller's listings. An unknown seller, or one on either side of the caller's blocks, finds none.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: relevance by default with q, photo or like, newest without. nearby goes without q, photo and like, and scores the listings by distance and age. nearest and nearby need a position and keep within 50 km without radius_km. The other sorts order the listings the search found.

parameters.name: off
parameters.description: Chip IDs to leave out; the cached understanding is reused.

Vary.description: Accept-Language, on a response whose text follows the request's language, so a cache keeps one copy per language.

400.description: A malformed parameter, position_required, invalid_position, invalid_province, invalid_cursor, invalid_price_range, or search_conflict: photo with q or like, sort=nearby with q, photo or like, or watch with any parameter but cursor, limit, sort and off, seller included.

404.description: listing_not_found: like names a listing that is not on sale or reserved; watch_not_found: watch is not a watch of the caller's.

post.description:
A batch of up to 50 events from the website or the Android app: a
script error, a Core Web Vital, how long a request took on the client,
and which search results were shown and which was opened. The server
turns them into metrics and log lines and keeps no rows. Anyone may
call it, signed in or not, up to 2 batches a second from one address
in bursts of 60.

post.summary: Sign a console member in.
post.description:
Every call sends the email and password. The first sign-in takes up to
three calls: one that answers password_change_required, one with
new_password that answers totp_enrollment_required (the console then
calls totp-enrollment), and one with the new password and a code.
Later sign-ins send the password and a code together.

An unknown email, a wrong password and a disabled member all get
invalid_credentials. Each call counts toward the email's lock until the
password proves right; a wrong code counts too. Five failures on one
email lock it for 15 minutes, whether or not a member has the email.
Success sets the console_session cookie.

alone, the conversations about records of that kind. With none, the
caller's conversations without a record. Newest activity first.

post.summary: Open the agent conversation of a record, or start one of the caller's own.
post.description:
A record has one conversation, shared by every member: the first call
for a subject makes it, and later calls answer the same one. Without a
subject the conversation is new and the caller's; a repeated
Idempotency-Key answers the conversation its first call made.

get.summary: One agent conversation with its messages and turns, oldest first.
get.description:
The messages are the conversation's history as the model reads it:
what members wrote, what the agent answered, the commands it ran and
what they printed. Each turn names the member who started it.

patch.description: A member renames their own conversation without a subject, an admin any. Another member's own is not found; a ticket's or an account's shared conversation is an admin's (agent_forbidden).

403.description: A shared conversation, for a moderator (agent_forbidden).

422.description: The title is empty or longer than 80 characters (agent_title_invalid).

delete.summary: Delete a conversation with its messages, turns and approvals.
delete.description: Who may is as for the rename. A conversation with a turn running is refused (agent_turn_in_progress).

403.description: A shared conversation, for a moderator (agent_forbidden).

409.description: A turn of the conversation is running (agent_turn_in_progress).

post.summary: Write to a console agent in a conversation; its turn starts and the answer comes on the turn's events.
post.description:
The server adds the message to the conversation, opens the turn as
running and starts its run on the agent runtime with the picked
agent (the Console assistant when agent_id is left out), then
answers 202 with the turn's id; the console opens GET
/v1/console/agent/turns/{id}/events to watch it. Closing the stream
does not stop the run. A repeated Idempotency-Key answers the turn
its first call opened and starts no run.

404.description: No such conversation (agent_conversation_not_found), or agent_id is no console agent (ai_agent_not_found).

409.description: A turn is still running in this conversation (agent_turn_in_progress) or the agent is turned off (ai_agent_disabled).

422.description: The message is empty once trimmed (agent_input_rejected).

429.description: The member asked too much in a short time (agent_rate_limited).

get.summary: One turn.
get.description: Its status, why it stopped, its usage, and last_seq, where a page that loads opens the stream.

get.summary: A turn's run as server-sent events, replayed after Last-Event-ID and then live.
get.description:
text/event-stream. Each event has `id:` its seq and `data:` one
AgentRunEvent as JSON; a comment line keeps the connection open. The
server replays the turn's events after the given seq and then follows
the run live, so a closed tab reconnects with Last-Event-ID, or with
after in the query on a page load. The stream ends after turn.paused
or turn.finished; after a resume the console opens it again from its
last seq. Closing the stream does not stop the run.

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID
parameters.description: The seq of the last event the console has.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Last-Event-ID for a stream the page opens itself; the header wins.

post.summary: Pause a run before its next model call.
post.description: The commands the agent is running finish first, so none is cut halfway (turn.pausing, then turn.paused). A paused turn resumes with POST .../resume or a new message. To cut the commands short, stop the turn.

202.description: Taken; the run's events show it.

post.summary: Stop a run now.
post.description: Ends the model call and the commands in flight at once; the agent reads that a staff member stopped them. The turn goes stopped and keeps what it wrote; it resumes as a paused one does.

202.description: Taken; the run's events show it.

post.summary: Resume the conversation's last turn where it ended, with no new message.
post.description: Takes a paused, stopped, failed or timed out turn that is its conversation's last. The turn runs again on the history it left (turn.resumed); the console opens the stream again from its last seq.

post.summary: Write to a running turn; the agent reads it before its next model call.
post.description: The message joins the conversation at the next step (in the step event's messages). A turn that is not running takes a new message instead (POST .../conversations/{id}/turns).

get.summary: The API operations an agent may be given, by capability.
get.description:
For a member, every operation an agent may hold through its
capabilities, for the AI settings. For an agent's turn, the ones its
agent holds: the commands of the shopnexus CLI in its sandbox. An
operation with approval set changes something: the agent's call does
not run it but answers 202 with an approval that a member approves or
rejects (GET /v1/console/agent/approvals). Each operation's body is
its request body's JSON Schema with the references resolved.

get.summary: The changes agents asked for, newest first.
get.description:
A member sees the approvals of the conversations they may open;
without conversation_id, every one of those, so at most 100. An
agent's turn sees its own conversation's only, so it can tell what
became of the changes it asked for.

post.summary: Approve a change an agent asked for; the server makes the call as the approver.
post.description:
The stored request runs now with the approver's session and rights,
as if they had made it: a role too low or a record that changed
since fails it like any call. The approval answers with the call's
status and body: approved for a 2xx, failed otherwise. Any member
who may open the conversation may approve.

post.summary: Reject a change an agent asked for.

get.summary: The console agents a member may pick in the ask box.
get.description: The agents turned on; the Console assistant is the default.

get.summary: The providers Bifrost runs, each with its status over the last hour. Admins only.
get.description: Read-only: a new provider or key is an infra change. status is unknown with no request in the last hour; down when Bifrost marks the provider's status error, or when at least half of at least 5 requests failed; degraded when at least 5% of at least 20 requests failed; else ok.

get.summary: A provider's catalog in Bifrost, each model with its list price. Admins only.
get.description: The model picker reads it; a model's list price is where its price starts.

404.description: Bifrost runs no such provider (ai_provider_not_found).

get.summary: Every model an agent uses, or that has a price or tags, with its price and its catalog's. Admins only.

put.summary: Replace a model's tags. Admins only; each change is a console action.
put.description: The model is in the body, as its id may hold a slash. An agent that requires a tag the model loses keeps running on it.

put.summary: Set a model's price, new or over the old. Admins only; each change is a console action.
put.description: One price per model, shared by the agents that use it. Bifrost logs each call's cost with it, which the agents' budgets and spend count. The model is in the body, as its id may hold a slash.

404.description: Bifrost runs no such provider (ai_provider_not_found).

get.summary: The app agents and the console agents, each with this month's spend. Admins only.
get.description: When Bifrost cannot be read, budget_spent_usd and budget_resets_at are null and the rest answers.

post.summary: Make a console agent. Admins only; each change is a console action.
post.description: The model and each fallback must have a price and carry the required tags; an agent that requires Embedding takes no fallback. The agent gets one caller named after its slug. The agent is saved first, then written into Bifrost; after 503 the same create again answers the saved agent.

409.description: Another agent or caller has this name or slug (ai_agent_taken).

get.summary: Each agent's requests by day over a range. Admins only.
get.description: A console agent's are its turns; an app agent's are its team's requests in Bifrost.

get.summary: What the console agents did over a range. Admins only.
get.description:
Each agent's API calls by operation (how many waited for approval,
how many failed, how long they took), its turns by how they ended
(stop: loop, context_full, length, deadline, budget), its approvals
by status, and how often the rate limit refused a member's message.

patch.summary: Change an agent. Admins only; each change is a console action.
patch.description: The agent is saved first; a new model, fallbacks, budget, callers' limits or on/off is then written into Bifrost, so the code that calls the agent needs no deploy. After 503 the change is saved and Bifrost takes it within 5 minutes. New instructions are a new version.

404.description: No such agent (ai_agent_not_found).

409.description: Another agent has this name (ai_agent_taken), or the agent changed meanwhile (try_again).

get.summary: An agent's instructions, newest first. Admins only.

404.description: No such agent (ai_agent_not_found).

get.summary: The spend of each UTC day from from to to, in all and by agent, as Bifrost logged it. Admins only.
get.description: At most 366 days (else ai_spend_range_invalid). Bifrost's totals trail real time by up to lag_s seconds.

422.description: to is before from, or the range is longer than 366 days (ai_spend_range_invalid).

get.summary: The ops dashboards and the lowest role that opens each. Admins only.
get.description: Moderators read the same list on GET /v1/console/me.

patch.summary: Change dashboards' floors. Admins only; each change is a console action.
patch.description: The ticket and the dashboards' forwardAuth check read the new floor at once, so a dashboard session of a member below it is refused on its next request.

post.summary: A one-time ticket that opens an ops dashboard on its own host.
post.description:
The console asks for a ticket, then sends the browser to callback_url,
where the server turns the ticket into the dashboard's cookie. A
ticket opens the dashboard once, within 60 seconds, and only while
this session lives. Grafana takes a moderator; the other dashboards
take an admin. A dashboard that DASHBOARD_HOSTS gives no host is
dashboard_not_configured.

get.summary: Traefik's forwardAuth check in front of every ops dashboard.
get.description:
Traefik calls it with the dashboard request's Cookie and its
X-Forwarded-* headers; no console header. X-Forwarded-Host names the
dashboard through DASHBOARD_HOSTS, and the console_dashboard cookie
must belong to that dashboard and to a console session that still
lives, of a member whose role opens the dashboard. Without such a
cookie a GET is sent to the console, which asks for a ticket; any
other method gets 401. Traefik copies X-Console-Email and X-Console-Role
onto the request it lets through and drops a client's own.

parameters.name: X-Forwarded-Host
parameters.description: The dashboard's host; a port is ignored.

parameters.name: X-Forwarded-Uri
parameters.description: The path and query the browser asked the dashboard for.

parameters.name: X-Forwarded-Method
parameters.description: The dashboard request's method; absent counts as GET.

X-Console-Role.description: Admin or Viewer for Grafana, whose auth proxy reads its own role names; the member's role (admin, moderator) for the others.

302.description: No cookie for this dashboard. Location is the console's /dashboards/open?app=<app>&rd=<X-Forwarded-Uri>.

403.description: The member's role does not open this dashboard (console_forbidden), or DASHBOARD_HOSTS does not name the host (dashboard_host_unknown).

get.summary: Turn a dashboard ticket into the dashboard's cookie.
get.description:
Served on each dashboard's own host, where the Ingress routes
/_dashboard to the server without forwardAuth. The request's Host
names the dashboard. The ticket must be unused, unexpired, for this
dashboard and of a console session that still lives; it is spent here.
The answer sets console_dashboard (Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax,
Path=/, no Domain, so only this host gets it) for as long as the
console session has left, and redirects to rd when rd is a path on
this host, to / otherwise.

parameters.name: rd
parameters.description: Where to go on this host afterwards, a path such as /d/abc?from=now-1h.

401.description: The ticket is unknown, used, expired, for another dashboard, or its console session has ended (invalid_dashboard_ticket).

403.description: DASHBOARD_HOSTS does not name this host (dashboard_host_unknown).

consoleAuth.name: console_session
consoleAuth.description:
The session cookie a console sign-in sets: HttpOnly, Secure,
SameSite=Strict, path /v1/console, eight hours. The server checks the
session and the member on every request.

dashboardAuth.name: console_dashboard
dashboardAuth.description:
The cookie of one ops dashboard's host, set by /_dashboard/callback:
HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax, path /, no Domain. It lives as long
as the console session it came from, and the server checks that
session and its member on every request.

price.description:
The price the person saw: the other side's open price or, for the
buyer, the listed price. Another price is 409 price_changed.

AccessToken.description: A new access token for the caller's session. The refresh token the app holds stays valid and is not replaced.

display_name.description: Empty until the person completes their profile.

avatar_url.description: A public 400 px square; absent without an avatar.

status.description: deleted is an account its person deleted; its name and bio are empty and it has no avatar.

away_until.description:
When away mode (tạm nghỉ) ends; absent when the person is not away.
Buyers cannot offer, accept or ask for COD on their listings before
then.

AccountUpdate.description:
The fields to change; at least one. The text and time rules are
business rules: breaking one answers 422 invalid_account with an entry
per field.

bio.description: At most 200 characters after trimming; may be empty.

avatar_upload_id.description:
An upload of the caller's, which becomes the avatar once processed
into a square; null removes the avatar.

away_until.description:
Turns away mode (tạm nghỉ) on until this time, which must be in the
future and at most 30 days ahead (422 invalid_account, field
away_until); null turns it off. Away mode ends by itself then.

display_name.description: The console member's name, or the OS user for the CLI.

details.description: What the action needs beyond its name, such as a suspension's reason and end. Never a secret. The report actions carry resolution_id; listing.hide and listing.unhide carry account_id, the listing's seller. The ai.* actions on a provider or a model carry its name, since their target id is a hash of it.

Address.description: Where the caller's parcels go. A COD request copies it into the order, so a later edit or delete leaves the order as it was.

province_code.description: The code of the commune's province, as GET /v1/regions lists it.

is_default.description: Exactly one address of an account with any is the default.

AddressDraft.description: An address as the person types it. The rules are business rules; breaking one is 422 invalid_address.

name.description: The recipient's name, 1 to 50 characters after trimming.

phone.description: A Vietnamese mobile number, in any common form.

kind.description: home, work or other (AddressKind); another value is 422 invalid_address.

is_default.description:
true makes the address the default in the same request. false or
absent leaves the default where it is: an address stops being the
default only when another one becomes it or it is deleted. The
first address of a book is the default either way.

AddressKind.description:
What the place is, so the shipper knows when to deliver: home (Nhà),
work (Công ty), an office that takes parcels in office hours, or other
(Khác). A COD order carries it to the carrier.

items.description: The default first, then the newest.

AgentApproval.description: A change an agent asked for, the API call it would make.

member_id.description: The member the agent worked for.

operation.description: The operation's name, as AgentOperation names it.

body.description: The request's JSON body; absent when it had none.

result_status.description: The HTTP status the call answered, once approved.

result.description: The call's JSON answer, once approved; absent when it had none.

AgentApprovalStatus.description: pending until a member decides; approved when the call answered 2xx, failed when it did not.

AgentConversationDetail.description: A conversation with its messages and turns, oldest first.

AgentConversationNew.description: A record to talk about, subject_kind and subject_id together, or neither for a conversation of the caller's own.

AgentMessage.description:
One message of a conversation's history, as the model reads it. A user
message is what a member wrote, with context, the facts the server put
in front of it (the time, the member, the conversation's record, the
approvals decided since the last turn). An assistant message is the
model's text, reasoning and the commands it ran (tool_calls); a tool
message is what one of them printed.

input.description: The call's arguments as the model wrote them, a JSON object.

AgentOperation.description: One API operation an agent may call, a command of the shopnexus CLI.

name.description: The operationId without Console, the CLI's command.

capability.description: The capability that grants it, its x-capability.

approval.description: It changes something, so an agent's call waits for a member's approval.

parameters.description: Its path and query parameters.

body.description: Its request body's JSON Schema; absent when it takes none.

agent_id.description: A console agent from GET /v1/console/agents; the Console assistant when left out.

AgentRunEvent.description:
The data of one server-sent event of a turn, `{seq, type, at, ...}`;
the event's `id:` is its seq, counted from 1 per turn. The fields
beside seq, type and at are those of the type:

- turn.started: agent {id, name}, model
- turn.resumed: by, the member who resumed it
- text.delta, reasoning.delta: delta, the model's text as it streams
- tool.started: call_id, tool, input
- tool.finished: call_id, tool, output (what the model reads),
  is_error
- step: messages, the AgentMessages the step added to the
  conversation (the model's message, its commands' outputs, and the
  steers it read)
- step.failed: error; the text streamed since the last step is void
- approval: approval, an AgentApproval asked for or decided
- steer: text, by; a member's steer the runtime took, which a later
  step carries as a user message once the model reads it. A turn that
  ends without such a step did not read it
- turn.pausing: by
- turn.paused: usage
- turn.finished: status, stop, error, usage

The stream ends after turn.paused or turn.finished.

AgentSubjectKind.description: The record a conversation is about.

AgentTurn.description: A turn of a conversation, in it and from GET /v1/console/agent/turns/{id}.

model.description: The model at the gateway, provider/model.

stop.description:
Why the run ended without an error, as the runtime says: done,
length (the answer hit the output limit), deadline, paused, stopped,
loop (the same calls gave the same results three steps running),
context_full, or budget (the model gateway refused: the agent's
budget is spent, and the turn failed).

error.description: What went wrong, for a failed turn.

last_seq.description: The seq of its last event; 0 before the first.

AgentTurnState.description: The turn a control was taken for.

AgentTurnStatus.description:
A turn's status. running until its run ends: paused when a member
paused it, stopped when one stopped it, succeeded when the agent
answered, timed_out past its deadline, failed otherwise. Every status
but running can take a new message; the conversation's last turn can
also resume.

input_tokens.description: Every input token, the cached ones included.

cached_tokens.description: The input read from the prompt cache.

kind.description: app agents are called by the server's code; console agents run in the agent service.

slug.description: The agent's stable name, its team's in Bifrost; set once.

fallbacks.description: The models Bifrost tries in order when the model fails.

capabilities.description: What a console agent may do through the API: each capability grants the operations whose x-capability names it (GET /v1/console/agent/operations lists them). An operation that changes something still waits for a member's approval.

monthly_budget_usd.description: The agent's budget per UTC month; null for none.

budget_spent_usd.description: This month's spend, as Bifrost counts it; null with no budget or when Bifrost cannot be read.

budget_resets_at.description: The 1st of next month (UTC), when the spend starts again; null as budget_spent_usd is.

held.description: The calls answered 202, changes that waited for approval.

stop.description: Why the run ended, as AgentTurn's stop; absent while running and for a failed run.

rate_limited.description: The members' messages and steers the rate limit refused.

AIAgentCaller.description: One virtual key of an agent, named after the code that calls it, with its rate limits per minute; null is no limit.

AIAgentLimits.description: A console agent's limits, sent to the agent service with each turn: the deadline (10 to 300 s, 60 by default), the model calls of a run segment, the context window, each tool call's time limit and attempts, and an answer's tokens; a field left out takes the agent service's default. An app agent's timeout_s is its call's time limit.

AIAgentNew.description: A console agent; its one caller is named after its slug.

AIAgentPatch.description: An app agent takes model, fallbacks, limits, monthly_budget_usd and callers only (else ai_agent_app_fixed).

callers.description: Every caller of the agent, each once, with its new rate limits; only the limits change (else ai_agent_invalid).

price.description: The model's price; null until an admin sets one, and an agent cannot run on it before.

catalog_price.description: The list price of the provider's catalog in Bifrost; null where the catalog has none.

agents.description: The agents that use the model, as their model or a fallback.

tags.description: Every tag, in order.

AIModelPrice.description: A model's price in USD per token; a negative one is refused (ai_price_invalid).

cache_read.description: Null or left out is the input price.

cache_write.description: Null or left out is the input price.

AIModelRef.description: A provider's model, which callers send Bifrost as provider/model_id.

AIPrice.description: USD per token. A null cache price is the input price.

AIProvider.description: A provider Bifrost runs from its config.json; a new one or a new key is an infra change.

name.description: The provider's name in Bifrost, the prefix of its models (upstream/claude-sonnet-5-5).

kind.description: A built-in provider's name, such as openrouter, or custom.

base_host.description: The host of the provider's base URL, when it has one.

error_share_1h.description: The share of the last hour's requests that failed.

requests_1h.description: The requests of the last hour.

model_count.description: The models of the provider's catalog in Bifrost.

model_id.description: The model as the provider names it, without the provider's prefix.

AIProviderStatus.description: unknown with no request in the last hour; down when Bifrost marks the provider's status error, or when error_share_1h is at least 0.5 over at least 5 requests; degraded when it is at least 0.05 over at least 20 requests; else ok.

days.description: Each UTC day from from to to, oldest first.

total_usd.description: Every call's cost, an agent's or not.

by_agent.description: Each agent's cost, by its slug.

lag_s.description: How many seconds Bifrost's totals may trail real time.

Block.description: An account the caller blocks. Neither may message the other, open a conversation with them or open a deal on their listings.

next_cursor.description: Present when more blocks follow; pass it as cursor.

Boost.description: One purchase of a package for one listing.

payment_url.description:
The gateway's payment page; present while awaiting_payment. Open it
in a browser tab. Once paid or cancelled the gateway sends the
browser to the server's return page, which opens
shopnexus://boost/{id}; the app then reads this boost again. Only
the server's own check with the gateway moves the status, never the
redirect.

payment_expires_at.description: Present while awaiting_payment; the payment expires then.

started_at.description: When the payment landed; the package's days count from it. The first move up happens then if the listing is on sale.

ends_at.description: When an active package ends; started_at plus its days.

next_bump_at.description: The next move up of an active package; absent after the last one.

last_bump_at.description: The latest move up the package made; a day the listing was not on sale makes none.

bumps.description: How many times the package moved the listing up.

ended_at.description: When the package ended, or the purchase closed without starting.

package.description: The id of one of GET /v1/boost-packages's items.

BoostPackage.description: A package a seller buys for one of their listings.

id.description: The package's code, such as 3d; POST /v1/boosts names it.

days.description: How long the package runs; the listing moves up once at the start and again every 24 hours.

price.description: In đồng, paid once through the payment gateway.

available.description: False when this server takes no payments; POST /v1/boosts then answers payment_unavailable.

BoostStatus.description:
awaiting_payment: the seller has 15 minutes to pay at payment_url.
active: paid and running. ended: the package ran its days. failed:
the gateway refused or the seller cancelled the payment. expired: not
paid within 15 minutes. Nothing is ever refunded: a payment that lands
starts its package, whether the listing is on sale then or not.

BumpedAt.description:
When a boost last moved the listing to the top of the newest order;
absent for a listing never boosted. The newest order sorts by the later
of this and published_at, so a card that shows a time shows the
original posted time with a small "Được đẩy" mark.

BuyerFigures.description: The caller as a buyer over the last 90 days.

cod_orders.description: The COD orders the caller placed.

failed.description: Of those, the orders whose delivery failed, not counting parcels the carrier lost.

CancelReason.description:
buyer and seller: that side cancelled a pending order. seller_timeout:
the seller created no shipment within 3 days. pickup_timeout: the
carrier had not picked the parcel up 3 days after the shipment.
shipped_to_another: the seller shipped the listing to another buyer.
listing_closed: the listing was hidden, sold off the app or deleted.

Carrier.description: A shipment's carrier. New shipments are at ghtk or ghn; spx, jt and viettel_post appear only on manual shipments from before 2026-11-25.

CarrierAccount.description: A carrier account the seller linked. The token never leaves the server.

shop_code.description: GHTK's shop code or GHN's ShopId.

linkable.description: The carriers this stack runs, the ones a seller can link now, in code order. A carrier it runs off is absent; an account kept there is still in items.

CarrierLogin.description: GHTK takes the seller's email and password; GHN takes the seller's API token and ShopId, or the phone of the seller's GHN account and the code GHN texted to it. A body holds one pair and nothing of the others.

password.description: GHTK's, used once to get the shop's token; never stored.

phone.description: The phone of the seller's GHN account, sent to POST /v1/carrier-accounts/ghn/otp first.

otp.description: The code GHN texted to phone; GHN makes the seller a shop with ShopNexus as its staff.

phone.description: The phone of the seller's GHN account, a Vietnamese mobile.

parent_code.description: Absent on a root. A listing takes a category with a parent.

display_name.description: The name in the request's language, as "Điện thoại" or "Phones".

specs.description: The specs a listing under it must fill, in order. Empty on a root and on "Khác".

spec_labels.description: The names of specs in Vietnamese, for apps that predate specs.

category_code.description: A subcategory code, null when the text reads as none.

items.description: The roots in order, then each root's subcategories in order.

key.description: Stays the same in every language, as brand or storage.

name.description: In the request's language, as "Hãng" or "Brand".

ChatQuote.description: The message a reply quotes, as it reads now.

blocked.description: A block stands between the two, either way, so neither can send a message.

other_read_message_id.description:
The newest message the other member has read, for "Đã xem" under the
caller's messages up to it. Absent while they have read nothing.

deals.description: The deals of the two people on either side, newest first, as the caller sees them.

ticket.description: Present for a support chat, whose other side is ShopNexus.

buyer_rating.description: The other member's rating as a buyer; present when the caller sells to them in one of the deals.

Chip.description: A signal the model read from the query; off=<id> leaves it out.

label.description:
In the request's language, as "Dưới 3 triệu" or "Under 3M ₫". A
phrase or a place reads as the model wrote it, in Vietnamese.

ChototAd.description:
One of the linked profile's listings on sale on Chợ Tốt.

- importable: may be brought over.
- importing: being brought over.
- imported: brought over; listing_id is the copy, null while it waits
  as a draft (see import).
- already_here: a listing of the caller's on ShopNexus, listing_id, has
  the same title and price, so it is not offered.
- unsupported: reason real_estate (Nhà Tốt), no_item or no_photos.

title.description: The listing's title on Chợ Tốt.

price.description: Null when the listing shows no price.

thumb_url.description: The cover on Chợ Tốt's CDN.

import.description: The caller's import of it, when there was one.

room.description: How many more listings the caller can put on sale before the cap of 20.

ChototCode.description:
The code the seller puts in their Chợ Tốt profile's "Giới thiệu về
trang" to show the profile is theirs. An account has one live code; it
lasts 30 minutes, and asking again before then answers the same code.

code.description: SN- and six characters without 0, O, 1, I or L.

ChototDraft.description:
The listing an import could not post, as far as it was filled, for the
posting form. Its photos are kept for 30 days.

price.description: The listing's price on Chợ Tốt; null when it is outside 10,000 to 1,000,000,000 đồng.

category_code.description: The subcategory guessed from the title and description; null when no guess came.

ChototImport.description:
What became of bringing one Chợ Tốt listing over. Each listing is
brought over once per account: importing it again answers this.

- importing: still running.
- listed: posted as listing_id, published like any post. review names
  the fields the import set without the listing on Chợ Tốt stating
  them (condition, set to used), for the seller to check; it empties
  once the seller edits the listing.
- draft: the listing rules refused to post it; review names the fields
  to fill (from invalid_listing), and missing_spec_keys the specs the
  category asks for. draft holds what was filled. POST
  /v1/me/chotot/ads/{list_id}/listing posts it.
- skipped: not brought over this time; reason says why
  (listing_cap_reached, account_suspended, phone_required, ad_gone, not_yours,
  unavailable). It may be imported again.
- unsupported: never brought over; reason is real_estate, no_item (not
  one item for sale) or no_photos.

ChototLink.description:
The caller's linked Chợ Tốt profile. ShopNexus only reads Chợ Tốt and
never writes to it. The settings start on.

oid.description: The profile's ID on Chợ Tốt, 32 hex digits.

name.description: The profile's display name, as Chợ Tốt showed it when it was last read.

avatar_url.description: The profile's photo on Chợ Tốt; null without one.

checked_at.description: When ShopNexus last read the profile's listings in the background, about once an hour; null before the first time.

imported.description: The profile's listings brought over and not deleted on ShopNexus, drafts included.

waiting.description: The profile's listings on sale that could still be brought over, as of the last read; null before one.

auto_import.description: Bring the profile's new listings over on their own, and notify the seller (chotot_imported).

follow_updates.description: When a listing on Chợ Tốt is sold or hidden, hide its copy here; when its price changes, change the copy's price.

remind_hide.description: When a copy here sells, notify the seller to hide the listing on Chợ Tốt (chotot_sold_here).

profile_url.description: The profile's address as Chợ Tốt shares it, https://www.chotot.com/user/<id>, with or without www, the scheme or a query.

ChototSettingsPatch.description: The settings to change; the others keep their values.

link.description: The caller's linked profile; null when none is linked.

ClientError.description: A script error the page did not catch. The app reports its crashes to Crashlytics instead.

page.description: The page's path, without its query.

ClientEvent.description: One thing the client saw, picked by type.

ClientRequest.description: One API call as the client timed it, network included.

path.description: The request's path, without its query. The server reads the route from it.

status.description: The response's status, 0 when none came.

trace_id.description: The trace id the client sent in traceparent, which the response's Trace-Id header repeats.

span_id.description: The parent span id the client sent in traceparent.

started_at.description: When the client sent the request. With trace_id and span_id, the server records the client's span, under which its own spans of the call hang; one more than an hour old or ahead of the server's clock is left out.

shipping_estimate.description: Null on every call until the server has a pre-order estimator; the field is there for it.

price.description: The price the buyer saw. On an agreed deal, the agreed price. On a deal still negotiating, the listed price or the seller's open counter; the order agrees the deal at it. Any other price is price_changed.

address_id.description: An address of the caller's from GET /v1/addresses. The order keeps a copy, so a later edit or delete of the address leaves it as it was.

items.description: By display name; empty for an unknown province.

contact.description: The phone number, or the email address without one, to tell apart accounts that have no name.

actions.description: The 20 latest console actions on the account, newest first.

total.description: With status, how many accounts are in that status now, whatever q and the page.

default.description: The agent a question goes to when it names none.

ConsoleBoost.description: A boost of a listing with its payment, as staff read them.

next_cursor.description: Present when more boosts follow; pass it as cursor.

screen.description: The app screen or the website's route it was sent from.

contact.description: Whether ShopNexus may ask the person more, through Hỗ trợ.

page_url.description: The website's page it was sent on.

root_id.description: The root of its group; its own id for a root.

group.description: The rest of its group, the root included, newest first.

feedback_id.description: A feedback of the group to join.

note.description: The short note the app shows with the status.

version.description: The app version that has it; only with shipped.

ConsoleListing.description: A listing in any status but deleted, as the console's listing page shows it.

hidden.description: Set while a console member keeps the listing hidden.

report_case_id.description: The seller's account id, the id of the report case the listing's reports are in, when there are any.

reports.description: The reports about this listing in the seller's open case, or its latest resolved one.

price_guide.description: The median of similar listings of the category and condition, when the sample has any.

pct_vs_guide.description: How far the price is above (positive) or below the median, in percent.

member.description: The member who wrote a ShopNexus reply; absent for the person's messages and for an automatic one.

automatic.description: A message ShopNexus sent by itself, such as the note when a carrier request closes.

code.description: The order code the carrier knows.

created_at.description: When the buyer asked for the order.

carrier_now.description: What the carrier says of the parcel now, for a shipment on the seller's carrier account.

carrier_error.description: The code of why the carrier could not be read.

tickets.description: The support tickets about the order.

rating.description: The average of the seller's reviews, when there is one.

last_line.description: The ticket chat's last message, quoted data.

id.description: Also the order reference the gateway shows (vnp_TxnRef), without its hyphens.

gateway_ref.description: The gateway's transaction number, once it reported one.

bank_code.description: The bank or method the payer used, as the gateway names it.

result_code.description: The gateway's response code of the payment result, such as 00 or 24.

reply_to.description: A sent message of the ticket's chat the reply quotes.

person_contact.description: The person's phone number, or email address without one.

last_text.description: The last message's text, for the queue row.

same_carrier_30d.description: carrier_request only; tickets naming the same carrier in 30 days, this one included.

other_read_message_id.description:
The newest message the other member has read, for "Đã xem" under the
caller's messages up to it. Absent while they have read nothing.

listing_id.description: Someone else's active listing; the first message names it.

text.description: 1 to 1,000 characters after trimming, unless photos are sent.

temporary_password.description: Shown once; the member must replace it at the first sign-in.

ticket.description: Opaque; opens the dashboard once within 60 seconds.

app.description: Grafana opens for moderators and admins; the others for admins.

The conversation of the buyer and the seller, which opening the deal
opened or reused. Each move a person makes and each order step adds a
message there.

next_cursor.description: Present when more deals follow; pass it as cursor.

DealListing.description: The deal's listing as it is now.

cover_thumb_url.description: Absent until the cover photo is processed.

DealStatus.description:
Agreeing reserves nothing; several buyers may agree a price on one
listing. sold: the deal's order was completed; the deal takes no move.

DealSummary.description: A deal at a glance, as the caller sees it.

conversation_id.description: The conversation of the buyer and the seller, which holds the deal's messages.

your_turn.description:
The caller has to act: the deal is negotiating and the open price is
the other side's; or the caller is the buyer of an agreed deal
without a pending or shipped order, on a listing still active; or
the caller is the seller and the deal's newest order is pending.

DevUpdate.description: An update to log for the caller, with exactly the IDs its kind carries.

resend_at.description: The first moment another code to this address is allowed.

email.description: Trimmed and lower-cased by the server.

Error.description: The body of every error response.

code.description: Stable, snake_case; clients map it to their own text.

fields.description: One entry per invalid field, keyed by its JSON path, in English for developers.

field_codes.description:
The code of each entry in fields, by the same keys, so a client
writes the problem in its own words: required, too_short,
too_long (text), too_few, too_many (lists), out_of_range,
off_step (an amount between two steps), invalid (type or
format), not_allowed (a value the field does not take there),
unknown (names nothing that exists, or a property the schema
lacks), duplicate, one_of (takes exactly one of several fields),
missing_specs (with details.missing_spec_keys) or in_use. More may come; a client reads an unknown code as
invalid.

details.description: Values a client acts on. An operation's error description names the ones its codes send; an error without one has no details.

retry_after.description: Seconds to wait before trying again, rounded up, sent with otp_too_soon, otp_limit and login_locked.

attempts_left.description: Guesses the code still takes, sent with invalid_code. With 1 left, a wrong guess answers code_locked.

reason.description: What the carrier answered, in its words and language, sent with carrier_refused.

missing_spec_keys.description: The keys of the specs the listing's category asks for that it lacks, in the category's order, sent with invalid_listing when field_codes.specs is missing_specs.

profile.description: The Chợ Tốt profile the server read, sent with code_not_found.

boost_id.description: The boost that runs on the listing (boost_active) or awaits payment on it (boost_pending).

mood.description: Absent when the person picked none.

text.description: Absent when the person wrote none.

photos.description: The screenshots in their order; empty without any.

status_note.description:
Staff's short note on the status: for in_progress something like
"Dự kiến bản 2.6", for shipped the headline, like "Bộ lọc Size khung
đã có".

shipped_version.description: The app version that has it, with shipped.

others.description: How many other people's feedback staff joined to this one, for "Bạn và 12 người khác".

hearted.description: Staff hearted it; the app shows it on praise.

status_at.description: When the status last changed; created_at at first.

FeedbackDevice.description: The phone or browser it was sent from, for staff.

model.description: The phone, or the browser with its version.

app_version.description: The app's version; none from a browser.

Feedback needs a mood or a text that is not blank (invalid_feedback, with

moods.description: How many gave each mood, 1 to 5.
