display_name.description: Empty for a person without a name or a deleted account.

contact.description: The phone number, or the email address without one.

url.description: The photo, at most 1600 px on its long side.

FeedbackSource.description: Where it was sent from, the app or the website; app when absent.

FeedbackStatus.description:
sent until staff read it; seen once they did; in_progress while ShopNexus
works on it; shipped once a version has it.

FeedbackSummary.description: The last 30 days; a mood of 0 is none.

day_mood.description: Each day's mean mood, oldest first.

mood_before.description: The mean mood of the 30 days before.

waiting.description: Feedback still sent, at any age.

shipped_people.description: The feedback in the groups shipped.

avatar_url.description: A public 400 px square; absent without an avatar.

next_cursor.description: Present when more follows follow; pass it as cursor.

HomeCategory.description: A root of the category tree.

notifications_unread.description: The reader's unread notices; 0 when signed out.

nearby.description: The first page of the nearby feed; no items without a position.

for_you.description:
Dành cho bạn, active listings nationwide. A signed-in reader's
listings come first from the subcategories of their signals of the
last 30 days: the newest 100 listings they saved, the newest 100
they opened, and those of their last 10 searches that fall in the
window and named a subcategory, the 5 subcategories weighing most.
The listings are ordered by the weight of their subcategory, then
newest first. The newest listings
of any other subcategory follow. A signed-out reader, or one with no
signal, gets the newest listings. Each listing appears at most once,
and the reader's own listings, those they hid and those of the
accounts on either side of their blocks are left out.

viewed.description: Absent when signed out, without a listing opened in the last 30 days, or when the subcategory has no listing to show.

HomeSubcategory.description: A subcategory under a root of the category tree.

HomeViewed.description:
Vì bạn đã xem gần đây, read from the newest 100 listings the reader
opened in the last 30 days. Of those opened on the latest day among
them, category is the subcategory most of them have; a tie goes to the
subcategory of the most recently created one. items are the active
listings of category outside those 100, newest first, with the
exclusions of for_you.

value.description: The number in the +84 form, or the address lower-cased.

InboxItem.description:
deal is the pair's deal the row is about, absent when the two have none:
the newest, by last move, of those where it is the caller's turn, else
the newest negotiating or agreed one, else the newest. order_status is
that of the deal's newest order. scam_warning is absent when the caller
has no warning in the conversation.

unread.description: The other member's sent messages after the caller's read marker; at least 1 while the caller's unread mark is set.

other_active_deals.description: The pair's negotiating or agreed deals besides deal.

next_cursor.description: Present when more conversations follow; pass it as cursor.

unread.description: The caller's unread messages over unarchived conversations, as GET /v1/me/unread counts them.

next_cursor.description: Present when more messages follow; pass it as cursor.

key.description: The key; the website serves it at /<key>.txt.

LinkedCarrier.description: The carriers with a client. A seller links those the stack runs; one it runs off answers 503 carrier_unavailable. The other carriers in Carrier cannot be linked yet.

published_at.description: When the listing first went on sale; a boost never changes it.

ListingDraft.description:
A listing the caller started and has not posted, kept for their other
devices until expires_at, 30 days after its last PUT. Photos a listing
took or that expired are left out.

ListingDraftInput.description:
A draft as the app has it. The server reads title, price and photos and
keeps body as it came, without reading it; the posting rules apply only
at POST /v1/listings.

schema_version.description: The layout of body, which the app defines.

price.description: Whole đồng, or null while the seller has typed none.

photos.description:
Upload IDs of the caller's, in order. A photo a listing took, or one
that expired, is dropped from the stored draft; an ID given twice is
kept once. Each photo kept is kept 30 days from this PUT.

body.description: JSON the app owns, as a string.

url.description: A presigned GET of the original upload, valid for an hour.

ListingInput.description:
A complete listing, to post or to replace one. The rules below are
business rules: breaking one answers 422 invalid_listing with an entry
per field.

description.description: At most 1,500 characters; may be empty.

category_code.description: A subcategory code from GET /v1/categories, such as phones.iphone.

photos.description: 1 to 10 upload IDs, in order; the first is the cover.

specs.description: Up to 20 specs, with a value for each of the category's specs.

gps.description:
The seller's position, sent only with their permission. The server
blurs it to about 1 km before storing it and never returns it. A
point farther than 30 km from the commune is 422 invalid_listing on
field gps.

ListingOrder.description:
The order on the listing the seller acts on: the shipped one, else the
pending order requested first. Absent while none is pending or shipped.

ListingRead.description:
A read of a seller's video or photo into a listing draft. Fields fill
in as its steps finish: photos after the frames step of a video, draft
when the read is done. A
field not reached yet is absent, and so is a field of another source. A
video is deleted when its read ends; the read is kept 24 hours. GET
/v1/listing-reads/{id}/events streams the title and description while
the model writes them.

failure_reason.description:
Only when status is failed, and only when there is one: why, in a
Vietnamese sentence for the seller. For no_item it is the model's
own reason; for unavailable, the error the model gave or what went
wrong asking it. Show it under the failure's own words.

photos.description:
A video's clearest frames in time order (at most 8), or the photo
read.

ListingReadRequest.description: What to read, exactly one of video and photo, with transcript only beside video.

video.description: A video upload of the caller's (video/mp4 or video/quicktime), uploaded and not read yet.

transcript.description:
What the phone's speech recognizer heard while the video was filmed,
taken as the seller's words. Blank or absent, the server hears the
video's sound. Never stored past the read, logged or returned.

photo.description:
A photo upload of the caller's, uploaded and not yet in a listing:
the cover. The read does not take it; post it in the listing.

distance_km.description:
Whole kilometres from the caller's position to the listing, 0 under
1 km; absent without a position. It sits beside the listing because
it depends on the request, and a Listing reads the same for everyone.

boost.description: The listing's boost awaiting payment or running, sent to its seller only; absent when none.

boostable.description:
Sent to the seller only: whether POST /v1/boosts would sell a
package for the listing now. True when the listing is on sale,
has no boost awaiting payment or running, the account may write and
has a phone, and the server takes payments.

ListingSlug.description:
The end of the listing's web address, /listings/{slug}: the title
without accents in lowercase words joined by hyphens, then the
listing's 8-character code. Only the code finds the listing, so an
address written before a title edit still works.

ListingStatus.description:
processing: the photos are being processed. active: on sale. hidden:
taken down by the seller, or by ShopNexus, and then only ShopNexus puts
it back on sale (listing_held). rejected: a photo was refused; the photo says
why, and an edit tries again. reserved: held while an order's parcel
travels; anyone may read it, and the seller cannot change it. sold: sold
off the app or through an order. deleted: removed by the seller; only a
save or a deal that names the listing still shows it. Only active and
reserved listings are public.

ListingViewer.description:
The reader's own ties to the listing, sent when the reader is signed in
and is not the seller.

saved.description: Whether the reader saved the listing.

conversation_id.description: The reader's conversation with the seller; absent when there is none.

ListingWeek.description: The last seven days of the caller's listings on sale.

askers.description: The people who first asked about one of the listings in the seven days, once per listing.

saves.description: The saves made in the seven days that still stand.

Location.description: A commune and its province, with a point inside the commune rather than where a seller or the caller is.

email.description: As typed; the server trims and lower-cases it, so this has no email format check.

new_password.description:
Replaces the temporary password at the first sign-in; ignored
afterwards. 12 to 128 characters, not the email and not the current
password. Later calls send it as password.

code.description: The TOTP code, once the member has started or finished enrollment.

dashboards.description: The ops dashboards and the lowest role that opens each, on GET /v1/console/me.

locked_until.description: Present while failed sign-ins lock the member's email.

must_change_password.description: True while the member holds a temporary password.

last_sign_in_at.description: The start of the member's newest session, on lists; absent before the first sign-in.

Message.description:
A message a member wrote, or a deal message the server wrote for a move
on a deal of the two. A deal message has deal, an empty text and no
photos, and nobody can send one.

sender_id.description:
The member who wrote the message or made the move. A deal message
for a move by the system (a carrier's report, a timer) has the ID of
ShopNexus, so it counts as unread for both members.

status.description: Only the sender sees a processing or failed message.

failure.description: Why media refused a photo, on a failed message, in English.

failure_code.description: failure as a code, as Photo.failure_code in catalog.yaml.

refs.description:
The ShopNexus links in text, as cards to draw in place of the URL:
a listing, a person, an order, a category or a search on the
website, or a shopnexus:// link of the app. A link to something
gone, hidden, or an order the reader is not a side of, has none and
stays text.

MessageDeal.description:
The move a deal message is about. Every move a person makes on a deal
writes one, and so does every order step, whoever made it. A change of
the listing (price_changed, offers_closed, listing_closed) writes none.

text.description: 1 to 1,000 characters after trimming, unless photos are sent.

photos.description: Up to 4 upload IDs of the caller's.

listing_id.description: A listing of either member the message is about.

reply_to.description:
A sent message of the same conversation the message quotes. A deal
message cannot be quoted. Anything else is invalid_message with
field reply_to.

next_cursor.description: Present when more messages follow; pass it as cursor.

url.description: Set once the photo is processed.

MessageRef.description: A link in a message and what it points at; the field of its kind is set.

url.description: The link exactly as it is written in the message's text.

by.description: system is the server, following a change of the listing, a carrier's report or a timer.

amount.description:
The offered or agreed price, the new listed price on price_changed,
the order's price on cod_requested, the carrier's fee on shipped when it gave one.

MyAccount.description: The caller's own account, with how it signs in.

display_name.description: Empty until the person completes their profile.

avatar_url.description: A public 400 px square; absent without an avatar.

away_until.description:
When away mode (tạm nghỉ) ends; absent when the person is not away.
Buyers cannot offer, accept or ask for COD on their listings before
then.

identities.description: How the account signs in. Posting, opening a deal and opening a chat need a phone.

from_chotot.description: The listing was brought over from the seller's Chợ Tốt profile.

boost.description: The listing's boost awaiting payment or running; absent when none.

boostable.description:
Whether POST /v1/boosts would sell a package for the listing now:
it is on sale, has no boost awaiting payment or running, the
account may write and has a phone, and the server takes payments.

next_cursor.description: Present when more listings follow; pass it as cursor.

text.description: What the notice says, in the language Accept-Language prefers.

at.description: When it last changed; a newer move on the same deal moves an unread notice up.

next_cursor.description: Present when more notices follow; pass it as cursor.

NotificationSettings.description:
Which notices push, and whether order notices are mailed. A switch that
is off stops the push or the mail only; the notice is still listed.
Search watch notices push by each watch's own bell, and the listing and
account notices always push. Account notices are always mailed too. No
push goes out during quiet hours; mail does.

offers.description: Offers, counters, agreements and their ends.

orders.description: COD requests, shipping, delivery, failed deliveries and cancellations.

price_cuts.description: A new low of a saved listing.

followed.description: A new listing of a seller the caller follows.

reviews.description: A review of the caller that shows, or a reply to the caller's review.

order_emails.description:
Mail each order notice to the account's email address too. An
account without one gets no mail.

amount.description:
Whole đồng in multiples of 1,000, inside the deal's offer_range. The
range is a business rule, so an amount outside it is 422.

OfferRange.description:
The amounts the viewer's next offer may take, both included. Absent when
the viewer may not offer now; the app bounds its input with it.

next_cursor.description: Present when more offers follow; pass it as cursor.

OffersScreenItem.description: A buyer's open offer, as its deal, with the buyer.

OpenPrice.description: The offer or counter waiting for the other side.

Order.description: A buyer's request for cash on delivery at the agreed price.

code.description: The order number, such as SN-100001.

completed_by.description: The stored completion actor; present on a completed order.

due_at.description:
When the server moves the order on unless someone acts first: a
pending order is cancelled with seller_timeout, a parcel still
waiting for pickup is cancelled with pickup_timeout, a delivered
one completes. Absent while no such wait runs.

OrderItem.description: An order with its deal and its listing as it is now.

completed_by.description: The stored completion actor; present on a completed order.

due_at.description:
When the server moves the order on unless someone acts first: a
pending order is cancelled with seller_timeout, a parcel still
waiting for pickup is cancelled with pickup_timeout, a delivered
one completes. Absent while no such wait runs.

OrderScreen.description: The selected order and its current deal, with the caller's review of the other party and theirs of the caller. The ticket is the buyer's only and absent for a seller.

their_review.description: The other party's review of the caller; null when they have not reviewed or deleted it.

tracking.description: The shipment's timeline; absent until its carrier reports something. The buyer gets the steps only.

next_cursor.description: Present when more orders follow; pass it as cursor.

cod_orders.description: Buying only. The caller's pending and shipped orders against the open COD order cap, as the checkout reads it. Absent for selling.

awaiting_shipment.description: Selling only. The caller's pending orders, which wait for the caller to create the shipment. Absent for buying.

OrdersScreenItem.description: An order with the other party and the caller's review of them.

OrderStatus.description:
pending: the buyer asked for COD; either side may cancel. shipped: the
seller created the shipment; the listing is reserved. completed: the
buyer confirmed receipt, or 3 days passed after the carrier reported
the parcel delivered. failed: the carrier returned the parcel, and
the listing is back on sale; or it lost or cancelled it after the
pickup, or knew it no more 30 days into transit, which leaves the
shipment lost and the listing hidden for its seller. Either way the deal
negotiates again. cancelled: before the shipment, or by the pickup
timeout.

OwnReview.description: The caller's review of the other side of an order. Dates and id are null before the first submission. Deleted reviews carry no stars or text. change_until is when the review shows or 7 days after the original created_at, whichever comes first; locked uses the same boundary as edits and deletion, and is true once the subject replied.

visible_at.description: When the other side and the public see the review; it waits for their review or 7 days after the order closed.

tags.description: The review's chips; absent without any and on a deleted review.

photos.description: The review's photos; absent on a deleted review.

PaymentNotifyAnswer.description: The answer VNPay expects from an IPN.

RspCode.description:
00 recorded; 01 no such payment; 02 already recorded; 04 the amount
differs; 97 the signature does not check; 99 another error, which
VNPay sends again.

avatar_url.description: A public 400 px square; absent without an avatar.

last_active_at.description:
When the person last had the app open, to the 30 seconds; absent
before the first time. The app shows "Đang hoạt động" under 5
minutes, otherwise how long ago.

deleted.description: The person deleted their account; display_name is empty and there is no avatar.

official.description: ShopNexus itself, the other side of every support chat.

away_until.description:
When the person's away mode (tạm nghỉ) ends; absent when they are
not away. Until then a buyer's offer, accept or COD request on
their listings answers 409 seller_away.

copied.description:
True for a photo ShopNexus copied from the seller's own listing on
another site (POST /v1/listing-reads); false for one taken or picked in
the app, and until the photo is processed. Read only.

url.description: The photo, at most 1600 px on its long side; set once processed.

thumb_url.description: A 400 px thumbnail; set once processed.

failure.description: Why processing refused the photo, on a rejected listing, in English.

failure_code.description:
failure as a code, for a client to write in its own words:
too_large, wrong_type, unreadable, too_many_pixels (over 40
megapixels, or 20 at 16 bits a channel), unknown_upload,
not_attached or other. More may come; a client reads an unknown
code as other.

PickupPoint.description: A pickup point the seller registered at the carrier.

PriceDrop.description:
The listing's last price change, sent while it is a drop of 5 % or more
made in the last 7 days. A later raise ends it, and a drop that follows
a raise in that week counts from the price before the raise.

source.description: Similar listings on the platform; the only source today.

estimate.description: The range of the listings most like the draft; null under 5 of them or when the comparison failed.

suggestions.description: fast before market; empty under 3 sold listings. fast is left out unless it is below market.

similar.description: The most similar listings first, sold within 180 days or on sale and published within 90.

sold_prices.description: The prices of the compared listings that sold, ascending.

live_prices.description: The prices of the compared listings on sale, ascending.

watchers.description:
One row per search watch, muted ones too, that a listing of this
draft would match by category, condition, area and words. The app
counts the rows whose price range holds its price and whose
offers_only its offers switch allows.

PriceGuideRequest.description: The draft as it stands in the Giá step; ListingInput's fields that price an item.

commune_code.description: The listing's commune; distances and watch areas are measured from its point.

photos.description: The caller's waiting photo uploads, the cover first. Without photos the text alone is compared.

days.description: The median whole days from publication to sale at this price.

key.description:
address is done when the address book holds an address, bio when the
bio is not empty, phone when the account has a phone identity,
avatar when it has an avatar.

ProfileTasksScreen.description: Hoàn thiện hồ sơ. The app counts the steps done and takes the first step not done as the next.

tasks.description: Every step, in the order the screen shows them.

address.description: The default address of the caller's address book; null when the book is empty.

ProofRequest.description:
Exactly one proof, phone_token, google_token or email_code: the body of
addMyIdentity and reauthenticateSession. SignInRequest repeats these
three properties beside device_name, since kin-openapi's JSON Schema
2020-12 compiler cannot follow this file's refs under allOf and
unevaluatedProperties.

phone_token.description: The token Firebase returned for the verified number.

google_token.description: The ID token Credential Manager returned for the Google account; it proves the account's email.

QuickReplies.description:
The caller's saved chat answers, in their order, which a composer
offers to put in the field. An account that never saved any reads
three defaults in the request's language.

items.description: An answer, with something besides spaces; the server trims it.

QuietHours.description:
In Vietnam time. The window may cross midnight; from is inside it and to
is not. A push skipped in the window is dropped, not delayed.

from.description: Start, as HH:MM on a 24-hour clock.

to.description: End, as HH:MM on a 24-hour clock; not the same as from.

average.description: The average stars over every review of the seller; 0 without reviews.

tags.description: How many of the reviews carry each tag, most used first, then by tag; a tag none carries is left out.

ids.description:
The notices this call marked read, as many as there were (the 90-day
retention bounds them). To undo it, pass them to POST
/v1/notifications/unread in chunks of at most 500.

ReadDraft.description:
ListingInput's fields as the read filled them. The model writes only
the title and the description; catalog guesses the category from them.
The seller adds the price, the category's specs and
commune_code (and gps when allowed), then posts it to POST /v1/listings.

category_code.description: A subcategory code, or empty when none was found.

condition.description: Always used; the seller changes it.

specs.description: Always empty; the seller fills the category's specs.

description.description: The seller's own words, restated, or for a photo read what the photo shows; empty when there is nothing.

price.description: Always null; the seller adds the price.

allow_offers.description: Always false; the seller sets it.

photos.description:
Upload IDs of the draft's photos, the cover first: a video read's
sharpest frame then the others in time order (at most 6), or a
photo read's photo.

upload_id.description: A photo upload of the caller's; post it in a listing's photos.

url.description: Where to read the JPEG, for one hour after this response.

ReadText.description: The title and description so far, each time whole; a retried step starts them again.

Recipient.description: The buyer's address as the order copied it from the address book.

phone.description: In the +84 form. Absent for the seller on a cancelled order.

street.description: Absent for the seller on a cancelled order.

text.description: 1 to 500 characters after trimming; a business rule, so another length is 422.

ReplyRate.description:
A conversation counts when another person started it about one of the
caller's listings, its first message is from the last 90 days, and that
message is more than 24 hours old or the caller has answered. It is
answered in time when the caller's first message in it came within 24
hours of the other person's first message.

percent.description: The conversations answered in time, as a percent of count, rounded down.

ReplyTime.description:
How soon the seller usually answers someone who writes about one of
their listings: the median wait over the answers of the last 30 days.
A wait starts at the other person's first message after the seller's
last one, when that came at least an hour before, or at the first
message of the conversation; the seller's next message ends it. minutes
is within 10 minutes, hour within an hour, hours within 6 hours and day
within 24 hours. Absent with fewer than 5 answers in the 30 days, or a
median over a day.

listing_id.description: The listing reported; absent for a report of an account.

account_id.description: The account reported, the seller for a listing.

conversation_id.description: The caller's conversation with the account the report came from; absent when none was named.

status.description: withdrawn once the caller withdrew it; resolved once ShopNexus closed the case it is part of; else open. A new or updated report is open.

ReportCase.description: The reports about one account, the seller for a listing report, that share one resolution. Withdrawn reports never count. listing is the case's most reported listing, a tie going to the one reported last, absent when only the account was reported; resolution is on a resolved case only.

reports.description: How many reports the case holds.

ReportCaseDetail.description: A case as ReportCase says; resolution is on a resolved case only.

listings.description: Every listing reported in the case, the most reported first.

total.description: With status=open, how many accounts have an open case, whatever the page.

listing_id.description: The listing reported; absent for a report of the account.

conversation_id.description: The reporter's conversation with the account the report came from; absent when none was named.
With account_id only, the caller's conversation with that account; another one is 422 invalid_report.

reason.description: banned, fake, scam or other; a business rule, so another value is 422.

note.description: At most 500 characters after trimming; may be empty.

photo_url.description: The cover photo's thumbnail; absent until the cover is processed.

next_cursor.description: Present when more reports follow; pass it as cursor.

ReportReasons.description: How many reports of the case give each reason; a reason no report gives is absent.

outcome.description: dismissed is "Không vi phạm"; actioned follows the member's hides or suspension.

ReputationCaps.description:
The caps every account has, and how much of each the caller uses.
listings counts the listings on sale, waiting for review, hidden or
refused, and those reserved for an order; cod_orders counts the
caller's orders as a buyer that are pending or shipped.

ReputationRating.description: The reviews the caller received as a seller, as the seller page counts them.

average.description: The average stars; null without reviews.

ReputationScreen.description: Uy tín của bạn. Every figure is read when the view is.

buyer_rating.description: The caller's rating as a buyer.

sold.description: The caller's listings sold, through an order or marked by hand, as the seller page counts them.

reply.description: The reply rate over the last 90 days; null while fewer than 5 conversations count.

tags.description: The reviewer's chips in their order; empty without any.

deleted.description: The reviewer deleted their account; display_name is empty and there is no avatar.

avatar_url.description: A public 400 px square; absent without an avatar.

reply.description: The subject's one reply; null without one.

photos.description: The reviewer's photos in their order; empty without any.

created_at.description: The first submission; the review changes only while hidden and for 7 days after it, and not after a reply.

stars.description: 1 to 5; a business rule, so another number is 422.

text.description: At most 500 characters after trimming; may be empty.

tags.description:
Quick chips from ReviewTag, each once. A review of a seller takes
as_described, quick_reply and well_packed; one of a buyer takes
quick_reply and on_time. Another value, or one of the other role,
is a business rule, so 422 invalid_review with a field on tags. []
removes them, and leaving the field out keeps the review's tags.

photos.description:
Upload IDs of the caller's photos, in the order they show; [] removes
them, and leaving the field out keeps the review's photos. Each is a
photo upload of the caller's, uploaded and not yet used elsewhere, or
already one of this review's.

ReviewHelpful.description: The people who found the review helpful.

marked.description:
Whether the reader marked the review helpful; present only when the
reader may mark it: signed in, and neither its reviewer nor its
subject.

next_cursor.description: Present when more reviews follow; pass it as cursor.

upload_id.description: What ReviewDraft.photos names to keep the photo.

url.description: The photo, at most 1600 px on its long side.

ReviewRole.description: The side the reviewed person was on. seller rates the person who sold, written by the buyer; buyer rates the person who bought, written by the seller.

ReviewTag.description:
A quick chip on a review. About a seller: as_described (Đúng mô tả),
quick_reply (Trả lời nhanh), well_packed (Gói kỹ). About a buyer:
quick_reply (Trả lời nhanh), on_time (Nhận hàng đúng hẹn).

below.description: Tell when the price falls below this.

next_cursor.description: Present when more saves follow; pass it as cursor.

saved_price.description: The listing's price when it was saved.

alert_below.description: The save's own alert level; absent when it has none.

listing.description: The listing as it is now. A hidden or deleted listing shows its status alone.

category_code.description: The listing's subcategory, such as phones.iphone.

commune.description: The name of the listing's commune.

commune_code.description: The code of the listing's commune, as in /v1/regions/{province_code}/communes.

phone.description: A Vietnamese mobile normalized to +84 on save; invalid values are 422 invalid_shipping_settings with field phone.

code.description:
prepayment_request, off_app_contact, suspicious_link,
sensitive_info_request, impersonation, fake_payment_proof, pressure,
new_account or price_far_below. More may come; the app shows an
unknown code with the Info icon.

params.description:
The numbers the code's sentence uses, so a client writes it from
code and params: days on new_account, percent on price_far_below.
Absent on a code whose sentence has none.

days.description: Whole days since the account was created.

percent.description: How far the price is under similar listings, in percent, rounded down.

text.description: Written by the server in the request's language, as "Tài khoản mới tạo 2 ngày" or "Account only 2 days old". Kept for older clients; a client writes its own from code and params.

message_id.description:
The other member's newest message in the check that found the
signal, so a client shows the warning under it. Absent when the
check read no message of theirs, and on signals found before
2026-11-20.

ScamWarning.description: What the caller is told about the other member of a conversation; that member never sees it.

signals.description: Oldest first; at least one is a message code.

dismissed.description:
True while no message code has appeared since the caller last
dismissed the warning. The inbox shows the warning either way; Chat
shows its banner only when this is false.

SearchClick.description: A search result the person opened.

position.description: Its position in the results, from 0.

SearchHistoryItem.description: A text search the caller made.

query.description: The words as the caller typed them.

title.description: The query with its first letter upper-cased.

category.description: The Vietnamese name of the category the search understood; absent when none.

photo_url.description: The first result's photo; absent when the search found nothing.

SearchImpression.description: Search results that came into view, in their order on the page.

search_id.description: The search_id of the search response that listed them.

offset.description: The position of the first one in the results, from 0.

SearchItem.description:
A listing as a browse surface shows it: a search page, Home's nearby
feed and the seller view. It carries no point of the listing.

photo_thumb_urls.description: The thumbnails of the listing's first five photos in order, the cover first.

category_code.description: The listing's subcategory, such as phones.iphone.

commune.description: The name of the listing's commune.

commune_code.description: The code of the listing's commune, as in /v1/regions/{province_code}/communes.

distance_km.description: Whole kilometres from the caller's position, 0 under 1 km; absent without a position.

published_at.description: When the listing first went on sale.

next_cursor.description: Present when more listings follow; pass it as cursor.

search_id.description: Names this response; the client sends it back with the search events of POST /v1/client-events.

next_cursor.description: Present when more listings follow, up to the 500th.

preview_chips.description: Signed out, on a first page with q: the chips the model read for the same query when a signed-in person searched it, from the cache. The search did not apply them; signing in does. Absent when nobody signed in searched the query.

watch_id.description: The caller's watch of this query; absent signed out, with seller, or when there is none.

query.description: The words as the caller typed them, trimmed.

area.description: The commune the watch searches from; absent without a place.

new_count.description: New listings since the caller last opened the watch; 99 means 99 or more.

category.description: A root or subcategory code from GET /v1/categories.

near_lat.description: With near_lng; turned into its nearest commune and not kept.

SellerProfile.description: The seller as the seller view shows them.

avatar_url.description: A public 400 px square; absent without an avatar.

rating.description: The rating as a seller, which search and the seller head use.

sold.description: Listings sold, through an order or marked by hand.

on_sale.description: Listings active or reserved for an order on its way.

followers.description: How many accounts follow the seller.

phone_verified.description:
Whether the person signs in with a phone number, which the sign-in
verified. The number itself is never sent.

last_active_at.description:
When the person last had the app open, to the 30 seconds; absent
before the first time. The app shows "Đang hoạt động" under 5
minutes, otherwise how long ago.

away_until.description:
When the seller's away mode (tạm nghỉ) ends; absent when they are
not away. Until then an offer, an accept or a COD request on their
listings answers 409 seller_away.

reviews.description: The first page of the person's reviews as a seller (Khi bán).

buyer_reviews.description: The first page of the person's reviews as a buyer (Khi mua).

SellerSummary.description: The seller of a listing, as the listing view shows them.

avatar_url.description: A public 400 px square; absent without an avatar.

sold.description: Listings sold, through an order or marked by hand.

phone_verified.description:
Whether the person signs in with a phone number, which the sign-in
verified. The number itself is never sent.

away_until.description:
When the seller's away mode (tạm nghỉ) ends; absent when they are
not away. Until then an offer, an accept or a COD request on their
listings answers 409 seller_away.

SellerViewer.description:
The reader's ties to the seller, sent when the reader is signed in and
is not the seller.

blocked.description: Whether either of the two blocks the other.

following.description: Whether the reader follows the seller.

conversation_id.description: The reader's conversation with the seller; absent when there is none.

current.description: True for the session the request was made with.

next_cursor.description: Present when more sessions follow; pass it as cursor.

Shipment.description: The parcel of a shipped order.

mode.description: linked is made on the seller's account at GHTK or GHN. manual is an order shipped before 2026-11-25, which the seller made on a carrier's own app and typed the code of; no new shipment is manual.

fee.description: The carrier's newest fee in đồng, from its reports and the poll; absent while the carrier has told none.

picked_up_at.description: When the carrier first reported the parcel past pending_pickup; absent while it waits for pickup.

delivered_at.description: When the carrier reported the parcel delivered; present while status is delivered.

ShipmentDraft.description: A shipment to make on the seller's account at GHTK or GHN.

carrier.description: ghtk or ghn, a carrier the caller linked; another value is 422 invalid_shipment, an unlinked one 409 carrier_not_linked.

pickup.description: home (the carrier picks the parcel up from the seller) or post_office (the seller brings it to one).

pickup_from.description: Where the carrier picks the parcel up, one of carrier_pickup_id, address_id or saved_pickup; absent, the carrier's default pickup point. The order keeps a copy.

carrier_pickup_id.description: One of the carrier's pickup points, from GET /v1/carrier-accounts/{carrier}/pickups.

saved_pickup.description: Use the caller's saved pickup address and contact phone with their current display name.

address_id.description: An address of the caller's from GET /v1/addresses.

ShipmentPickup.description: Where a linked shipment is picked up, as the order keeps it: a carrier's pickup point, or a copy of the seller's address.

ShipmentStatus.description:
Where the parcel is, as its carrier reports it. failed is a parcel
refused at the door and on its way back; lost is a parcel the carrier
lost after the pickup, or no longer knew 30 days after it. Either ends
the order failed; a lost one counts against neither side, takes no
review, and leaves the listing hidden for its seller.

ShipmentStep.description:
Where the parcel is, in the same words for every carrier, finer than
ShipmentStatus. ready_to_pick, picking and pickup_failed are
pending_pickup; picked, at_hub, transporting, out_for_delivery and
delivery_failed are in_transit, since the carrier tries a failed
delivery again; delivered is delivered; returning and returned are
failed. cancelled and lost are lost once the parcel was picked up, and
move no order before.

fee.description: The carrier's fee in đồng, read-only.

pickup.description: An owned address reference and separate unverified contact phone. Deleting the address clears both; existing shipment copies stay unchanged.

is_new.description: True when this sign-in created the account; the app then asks for a profile.

SignInRequest.description: Exactly one proof, phone_token, google_token or email_code, and the device's name.

phone_token.description: The token Firebase returned for the verified number.

google_token.description: The ID token Credential Manager returned for the Google account; it proves the account's email.

device_name.description: Shown in the list of signed-in devices.

km.description: Whole kilometres from the draft's commune.

listings.description: The parts of the public listings, newest first; none when no listing is public.

sellers.description: The parts of the sellers with a public listing, newest account first.

SitemapArea.description: A root category in a province, with at least 5 listings on sale.

category_code.description: A root category code from GET /v1/categories.

count.description: How many listings of the category are on sale in the province.

updated_at.description: The latest change to one of those listings.

SitemapCategory.description: A subcategory with at least 5 listings on sale.

updated_at.description: The latest change to one of its listings on sale.

slug.description: The listing's web address name, /listings/{slug} on the website.

photos.description: The public URLs of the listing's processed photos, in order, the cover first; the same URLs as the listing's photos[].url.

cursor.description: What GET /v1/sitemap/listings or /v1/sitemap/sellers takes for this part; absent on the first part.

updated_at.description: The latest change to an entry of the part.
The latest change to one of the seller's public listings.

SoldListing.description: A sold listing as anyone still sees it.

price.description: The price the listing asked when it sold; an order's agreed price stays with its two people.

key.description: The key of a spec the category asks for; absent on a spec the seller named.

label.description: A keyed spec's name in the request's language, as "Hãng" or "Brand"; the seller's own label on the others.

SpecInput.description:
A spec as a request sends it. A spec the category asks for goes by its
key from Category.specs, or by label alone, its name in any language
the server writes, case aside; either way the listing stores the key. Any
other label is a spec of the seller's own. A spec with neither key nor
label, a key the category lacks, or two specs of one key is 422
invalid_listing on field specs.

key.description: A key of the category's specs, such as brand.

label.description: 1 to 50 characters; read only when key is absent.

until.description: Absent for a suspension without an end.

Suspension.description:
Present only while the account is suspended. A suspended account stays
signed in but writes nothing new except in its support tickets.

reason.description: Why staff suspended the account, as they wrote it.

until.description: When the suspension ends; absent for one without an end.

Target.description:
The screen a notice opens. An order notice opens the order it is about,
which may be an earlier order of its deal than the latest; GET
/v1/screens/order/{order_id} reads it with its deal. An order notice
from before 2026-11-17 whose order the server could not tell opens its
deal instead.

id.description: The deal, order, listing, seller, search watch or feedback; empty for the account and chotot, the Chợ Tốt link; for chotot_ad, the listing's address on Chợ Tốt, https://www.chotot.com/<list_id>.htm.

TheirReview.description: The other side's review of the caller. A hidden one carries only when it shows; a visible one carries its stars, text, date and reply.

can_reply.description: Visible and without a reply. A reply closes the review for both sides.

tags.description: A visible review's chips; absent without any.

first_message_id.description: The message the app draws as the ticket's card; absent for a moment while the ticket opens.

first_message.description: The person's first message, the ticket's card: Hỗ trợ's second line, which names what a Yêu cầu khác asks.

carrier_name.description: carrier_request only; 1 to 50 characters after trimming (invalid_ticket).

text.description: The first message's text, at most 1000 characters after trimming; other needs it or a photo (invalid_ticket).

photos.description: Uploads of the first message, as a message's photos.

secret.description: Base32, for typing into an authenticator by hand.

Tracking.description: The parcel's timeline as its carrier reported it, through webhooks and the poll.

step.description: The newest step; absent before the carrier reported one.

TrackingEvent.description: One thing the carrier reported of the parcel. Fields the carrier did not send are absent.

at.description: When it happened, as the carrier tells it.

kind.description: step is a move of the parcel; weight, fee and cod a new weight in grams, fee or COD amount in đồng; cod_transfer the COD paid out to the seller. The buyer sees only steps.

carrier_status.description: The carrier's own status code on a step, such as GHN's storing or GHTK's 9, for a client that tells more than the step.

reason.description: The carrier's words on a failed pickup or delivery, a return or a delay.

warehouse.description: The carrier's hub the parcel is at.

proof_url.description: The carrier's photo of the delivery.

amount.description: The weight in grams, or the fee, the COD or the COD paid out in đồng.

unread.description: Unread messages over the caller's unarchived pair conversations.

offers.description: The buyers' open offers waiting on the caller as seller, as GET /v1/screens/offers lists them.

Update.description: A change for the caller, in their update log; IDs only.

has_more.description: More updates follow the last one; ask again from its seq.

content_type.description:
A photo, or a product video for POST /v1/listing-reads. HEIC is
converted to JPEG by the app before uploading.

size.description:
Bytes: a video at most 50 MB, a photo at most 15 MB. A photo over
15 MB is 400 invalid_request on field size.

headers.description: Headers the PUT must carry, as signed.

WebVital.description: A Core Web Vital of one page view, as the web-vitals library reports it.

value.description: Milliseconds, or the unitless layout shift score for CLS.

AgentApprovalNotFound.description: No such approval, or one of a conversation this member may not open (agent_approval_not_found).

AgentConversationNotFound.description: No such agent conversation, or one of another member's (agent_conversation_not_found).

AgentSubjectInvalid.description: subject_id without subject_kind, or a new conversation with subject_kind alone (agent_subject_invalid).

AgentTurnNotFound.description: No such turn, or not one this member may open (agent_turn_not_found).

AgentTurnState.description: The turn is not in a state that takes this control (agent_turn_state): pause, stop and steer take a running turn, resume the conversation's last turn once its run ended.

AgentUnavailable.description: The agent cannot be reached (agent_unavailable); the rest of the console works without it.

AIGatewayUnavailable.description: Bifrost cannot be reached (ai_gateway_unavailable). A change is saved and goes to Bifrost when it is back, within 5 minutes.

AISettingsRefused.description: A rule refuses the change: ai_model_unpriced (the model or a fallback has no price), ai_model_lacks_tags (it lacks a required tag), ai_tag_unknown, ai_agent_invalid (such as a caller not the agent's, or a fallback for an Embedding agent), ai_agent_app_fixed, ai_price_invalid, or Bifrost refused it (ai_gateway_refused).

BadRequest.description: The request does not match the API description (invalid_request, malformed_json).

ConsoleForbidden.description: The caller's role is too low (console_forbidden), or the target is an admin (admin_managed_by_cli).

NotFound.description: No such resource for this caller.

PreconditionRequired.description: The caller must do something first: sign in again (reauth_required), or at a console sign-in replace the temporary password (password_change_required), enroll TOTP (totp_enrollment_required) or send a code (totp_required).

TooManyRequests.description: Rate limited; details.retry_after gives seconds to wait when known.

Unauthorized.description: No valid credentials (unauthenticated, invalid_token, a refresh or session code, invalid_credentials, invalid_totp_code).

Unprocessable.description: Well formed, but a rule refuses it.

AcceptLanguage.name: Accept-Language
AcceptLanguage.description:
The caller's languages, as browsers and the apps send them. The server
writes in Vietnamese (vi) or English (en), whichever the header
prefers, and Vietnamese when it names neither. An email code is mailed,
and the text the server writes in a response (notices, category names,
search chips, scam signals, default quick replies) is written, in the
request's language; such a response sends Vary: Accept-Language. A
sign-in records it as the language of the account's pushes and mail.

AIProviderName.name: name
AIProviderName.description: The provider's name in Bifrost's config.json, such as upstream or openrouter.

ConsoleCSRF.name: X-Requested-With
ConsoleCSRF.description:
Must be shopnexus-console on every console call. A form or link on another
site cannot set it, which stops cross-site requests riding the session
cookie, sign-in included.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: The next_cursor of the previous page; absent for the first page.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: A new UUID per user action, reused when the app retries that action. A repeated key returns the first result.

IdempotencyKeyOptional.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKeyOptional.description: A new UUID per user action, reused when the client retries that action. A repeated key returns the first result. Without one, every request runs; the key is optional because earlier app versions send none.

NearCommune.name: near_commune
NearCommune.description: A commune code, when the app has no GPS; distance is from its point.

NearLat.name: near_lat
NearLat.description: The caller's latitude, with near_lng. Used for this request only; never stored or logged.

RadiusKm.name: radius_km
RadiusKm.description: Keep the listings within this many kilometres of the position, which it needs.

SearchCursor.name: cursor
SearchCursor.description: The next_cursor of the previous page.

SearchLike.name: like
SearchLike.description:
A listing on sale or reserved: listings similar to it, leaving out that
listing and the caller's own. Goes with q and the filters, not with photo.

SearchPhoto.name: photo
SearchPhoto.description:
An upload of the caller's from POST /v1/uploads, still waiting (attached to
nothing): search by this photo alone. Needs a signed-in caller; goes without
q and like. The photo is never published and goes when the upload expires.

SearchWatch.name: watch
SearchWatch.description:
A search watch of the caller's: search its query and filters from its
commune. Goes with cursor, limit, sort and off only, and needs a
signed-in caller. The first page sets the watch's new_count to 0.

SecPurpose.name: Sec-Purpose
SecPurpose.description:
The Fetch standard's purpose of the request. A list with the token
prefetch, such as prefetch or prefetch;prerender, marks a
speculative read: a browser fetching a page the person may not open.
Such a read answers as any other and records nothing; the client
reports the open when the person sees the page.

SitemapCursor.name: cursor
SitemapCursor.description: The part's cursor from GET /v1/sitemap; absent for the first part.
